title: The Solo Founder Playbook
subtitle: Building a High-Leverage Digital Product Business
reader_promise: You will learn how to design, ship, and automate a profitable digital product business as a single operator using modern leverage.

chapters.title: The Leverage Thesis
chapters.summary: Why traditional headcount scaling is obsolete for software and media businesses, and how modern leverage compounds.
key_points: The four types of leverage: labor, capital, code, and content
Eliminating coordination drag in single-operator setups
Designing products with zero marginal cost of reproduction

chapters.title: Asymmetric Product Design
chapters.summary: Selecting problems that reward speed and specialization while repelling legacy competitors.
key_points: Finding painful, recurring B2B problems with high willingness to pay
The MVP that hurts: shipping before comfort
Pricing on value instead of hours spent

chapters.title: Distribution Before Creation
chapters.summary: Securing demand channels and feedback loops before writing a single line of production code.
key_points: Building an audience in public without vanity metrics
The pre-sale mechanism that proves demand
